input_prompt: Mujhe mere landlord ki taraf se legal notice mila hai, please mujhe ise samajhne me help karo.
title: LawPilot AI Overview

citations.title: Duration of certain leases in absence of written contract or local usage
citations.description: In the absence of a contract or local law to the contrary, a lease of immovable property for other than agricultural or manufacturing purposes is deemed to be month-to-month, terminable on 15 days' notice expiring with the end of a month of the tenancy.

citations.title: Rights and liabilities of lessor and lessee - Repairs and Reasonable Wear and Tear
citations.description: Lessee is bound to keep and restore the property in as good condition as it was at the time he was put in possession, subject only to reasonable wear and tear and irresistible force. Landlord cannot make arbitrary deductions for normal usage painting without explicit contractual basis.

citations.title: Cap on Security Deposit and Condition for Deductions
citations.description: Limits security deposit for residential premises to a maximum of two months' rent. Requires refund of security deposit to the tenant at the time of taking over vacant possession of the premises, after making valid deductions agreed under the tenancy agreement.
citations.jurisdiction: Model Central Act (Adopted by States such as AP, TN, UP)

citations.title: Suit by person dispossessed of immovable property without due process
citations.description: If any person is dispossessed without his consent of immovable property otherwise than in due course of law, he or any person claiming through him may, by suit, recover possession thereof notwithstanding any other title that may be set up.

full_response:
Mujhe yeh jaan kar afsos hua ki aapko legal notice mila hai, par kripya ghabrayein nahi, kyunki ek legal notice ka matlab court ka faisla ya bedakhali ka aadesh nahi hota hai.

### | Your Situation (Aapki Situation)
Aapko apne landlord ki taraf se ek legal notice praapt hua hai aur aap iske mamle ko samajhna chahte hain. Is notice ka maqsad aam taur par aap par dabaav dalna ya kisi vivad ka formal jawab maangna hota hai.

### | Your Legal Position (Aapke Kanooni Adhikar)
*   Transfer of Property Act, 1882 ki Section 106 ke tahat, agar koi written contract nahi hai, toh tenancy ko khatam karne ke liye 15 din ka notice period dena anivarya hai.
*   Specific Relief Act, 1963 ki Section 6 ke anusar, kisi bhi kirayedaar ko kanooni prakriya (due process of law) ka palan kiye bina ghar se bahar nahi nikala ja sakta, aur na hi bijli ya paani jaisi zaroori suvidhaon ko kaata ja sakta hai.
*   Landlord aapki security deposit se sirf wahi paisa kaat sakta hai jo 'reasonable wear and tear' (normal istemal se hone wali ghisaavat) ke alawa koi bhari nuksan hua ho, jaisa ki Transfer of Property Act ki Section 108(m) mein bataya gaya hai.

### | Practical Next Steps (Agla Kadam)
1. Notice ko dhyan se padhein aur usme di gayi samay seema (deadline) ko note karein, kyunki jawab dena zaroori hota hai.
2. Notice ki ek copy ya uska text yahan share karein taaki main usey samajh kar aapko sahi salah de sakun (dhyan rahe ki apni personal jankari jaise Aadhaar ya bank details ko hata dein).
3. Ek baar notice samajhne ke baad, hum aapke vakil ya kanooni salahkar ke sath milkar iska ek formal jawab taiyar karenge jise 15-30 dino ke bhitar bhejna hota hai.

### ℹ️ Information I still need from you (Zaroori Jankari)
1. Kya aap is notice ki text ya photo yahan share kar sakte hain (personal details hide karke)?
2. Is notice mein landlord ne kaunsi mukhya maang ya aarop lagaye hain?
